objectives.label: Give {count} to the town's relief fund

title: The relief fund
Hard times for {settlement}
summary: {settlement} is in decline. The reeve asks its friends to give to the relief fund.
offer: You know how things stand: trade is down and families are packing their carts. I am asking the town's friends — the real ones — to give to the relief fund. Anything.
progress: Every coin keeps a family here.
complete: You have kept families in their homes. {settlement} will remember who stood by it.
